verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a silicon chip, not a software service, platform, or tool. Asking whether a processor ships an official MCP server for agent connectivity is a category error, and nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself exposes any MCP server. The Metal, MLX, and Core ML items are separate developer frameworks and are unrelated to MCP serving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
